Plus que dans n'importe quel autre secteur, il restera toujours pour l'homme qui travaille la terre des éléments incontrôlables qui vont conditionner le résultat de son travail. NewFarm Agriconsult oeuvre dans ce sens d'une part en mettant à disposition des services pour les agriculteurs et leurs conseillés sur internet et d'autre part en étant présent sur le terrain.

_crawl.about: Developing ecosystems, partnerships, and alliance programs are arguably one of the most overlooked, misunderstood, and underappreciated components of a company's strategy. Most CEOs and company executives admit that they do not know what their partner ecosystem should look like or how to get started. Not anymore! Who is PartnerReady? PartnerReady provides "Fractional Partner Leaders" to technology companies and service providers. Our fractional leaders are seasoned practitioners (partnership executives & leaders) who have spent years building and growing partnership programs BD & corp dev programs, and ecosystem strategies for large tech companies and startups alike. We have pioneered the concept of Fractional Partner Leadership, creating a much-needed expert leader adaptation, similar to how startups use Fractional CMOs or Fractional CFOs. Our practitioners work with clients from Seed Stage to Series B, serving as either fractional leaders or paid advisors. What is PartnerReady? Startup companies need the guidance of expert leadership in all operational departments. BD, Partnership, Channel & Ecosystem strategies are no exception. How a tech company gets involved in the greater ecosystem is one of the most critical activities a technology company can engage in; however, most companies fail to have a strategic plan, staff properly, or put in the proper partner support mechanisms. This lack of skilled focus leads to wasted time, money, and opportunity. PartnerReady de-risks the entire process of deploying time and resources to develop the partner and ecosystem strategies. We dramatically shorten the development cycles to get a company off in the right direction. Where is PartnerReady? PartnerReady is a virtual organization that is technologically equipped to allow our Partner Professionals to operate from anywhere in the world. Our partner professionals operate in North America & Europe, and we are currently launching an operating team in Southeast Asia.

## Natural foods for your holistic wellness,
## from organically grown crops.

For thousands of years we humans thrived upon natural foods. We ate foods that had been naturally
cultivated and offered by Mother Nature herself. Ever since the inception of industrialization, the
way the crops were cultivated has changed. As a result, the quality of our food has become a great
concern. Daivik comes forward to address this concern by offering you authentic natural food
products grown by certified organic farming practices. We change the notion of commercial farming
through sustainable farming practices to not only preserve your health but also the environment.
After all, the earth is our only home.

**“The integrity and credibility we have gained in the market is the
testimony to the authenticity of our products.”**

✅

You’re capable and hard-working. You know your garden can thrive. You’ve put in the time, the care,
and the heart. And yet, you often feel stuck and frustrated trying to make it all work.

✅

You’re confident with some things, but guessing with others. Your garden starts out strong, but it’s

The more I fought to fix ALL of the problems, the harder it became to manage my garden – and I just

Once I stopped fighting *against* my garden and focused on working *smarter* to create a healthy
environment that supported strong, resilient plants, everything clicked into place – and my garden
started to thrive on it’s own.

I’ll help you make that same shift in your garden, so you can skip the painful trial & error and

I’m here to help you shift away from *fighting* all of the problems as they pop up in your garden to
*working smarter* to create a healthy environment where plants can thrive.

Because once the bugs, weeds and diseases show up in your garden, it’s very hard to get rid of them
– and once your plants start to struggle, it’s often too late to save them.

**The smarter approach** is to create a *balanced* garden *ecosystem* that works with *nature* to
*prevent* problems before they start, and supports strong, resilient plants that can defend
themselves.

Let me show you my proven system for making this shift to growing smarter so your success is
inevitable and you can *love* your garden again.

## Your Gardening Success Cycle

When your garden’s ecosystem is balanced, it supports strong, resilient plants that can naturally
resist problems, so it practically takes care of itself.

That’s why I created the *Garden Growth Framework*™. A simple, repeatable, step-by-step system for
growing a thriving, low-maintenance garden you love.

## Here’s the strategy that actually works in YOUR garden:

[S1 Planning feature image of my vegetable garden layout.]

## Step 1: Planning

This is all about properly planning and designing your garden and choosing the best plants that will
thrive there, so not only will it *look* good, it’s set up the *right* way to prevent problems from
the start.

[S2 Planting feature image of Amy planting a shrub.]

## Step 2: Planting

Here’s where you’ll lay the foundation of your balanced ecosystem by prepping your soil and
installing everything correctly so your garden supports strong roots and healthy plant growth.

[S3 Nurturing feature image of Amy under her signature squash arch.]

## Step 3: Nurturing

This is all about caring for your plants in a way that improves growth, prevents problems before
they start, and strengthens your garden’s delicate ecosystem, instead of harming it or throwing it
out of whack.

[S4 Fixing feature image of row covers installed over garden plants.]

## Step 4: Fixing

This is where you know exactly what’s normal in your garden and what to watch out for so you can
easily catch problems early, and deal with them quickly to prevent them from spreading.

[S5 Improving feature image of Amy harvesting tomatoes from her garden.]

✅

You know how you want your garden to look. You can picture it in your head. But it isn’t turning out
that way, and it feels like a hot mess that stresses you out every time you look at it.

✅

You’re ready for gardening to feel easier and more consistent. You crave a system that actually
works in YOUR garden, right now, so you can get excited to go outside and enjoy it again.

**Then you’re in the right place!**

Hey there, I’m Amy Andrychowicz

[Picture of Amy Andrychowicz in front of her flower garden.]

## I’ve been there!

I spent years struggling and spinning my wheels, desperately trying to make my garden work.

The more I fought to fix ALL of the problems, the harder it became to manage my garden – and I just
kept thinking: “There’s *got* to be a better way!”.

Once I stopped fighting *against* my garden and focused on working *smarter* to create a healthy
environment that supported strong, resilient plants, everything clicked into place – and my garden
started to thrive on it’s own.

I’ll help you make that same shift in your garden, so you can skip the painful trial & error and
create a beautiful, highly productive garden that you love.

[MORE ABOUT AMY][10]

## The Smarter Way To Garden

**Stop fighting against your garden, and create one that practically takes care of itself!**

I’m here to help you shift away from *fighting* all of the problems as they pop up in your garden to
*working smarter* to create a healthy environment where plants can thrive.

Because once the bugs, weeds and diseases show up in your garden, it’s very hard to get rid of them
– and once your plants start to struggle, it’s often too late to save them.

**The smarter approach** is to create a *balanced* garden *ecosystem* that works with *nature* to
*prevent* problems before they start, and supports strong, resilient plants that can defend
themselves.

Let me show you my proven system for making this shift to growing smarter so your success is
inevitable and you can *love* your garden again.

## Your Gardening Success Cycle

When your garden’s ecosystem is balanced, it supports strong, resilient plants that can naturally
resist problems, so it practically takes care of itself.

That’s why I created the *Garden Growth Framework*™. A simple, repeatable, step-by-step system for
growing a thriving, low-maintenance garden you love.

## Here’s the strategy that actually works in YOUR garden:

[S1 Planning feature image of my vegetable garden layout.]

## Step 1: Planning

This is all about properly planning and designing your garden and choosing the best plants that will
thrive there, so not only will it *look* good, it’s set up the *right* way to prevent problems from
the start.

[S2 Planting feature image of Amy planting a shrub.]

## Step 2: Planting

Here’s where you’ll lay the foundation of your balanced ecosystem by prepping your soil and
installing everything correctly so your garden supports strong roots and healthy plant growth.

[S3 Nurturing feature image of Amy under her signature squash arch.]

## Step 3: Nurturing

This is all about caring for your plants in a way that improves growth, prevents problems before
they start, and strengthens your garden’s delicate ecosystem, instead of harming it or throwing it
out of whack.

[S4 Fixing feature image of row covers installed over garden plants.]

## Step 4: Fixing

This is where you know exactly what’s normal in your garden and what to watch out for so you can
easily catch problems early, and deal with them quickly to prevent them from spreading.

[S5 Improving feature image of Amy harvesting tomatoes from her garden.]

## Step 5: Improving

And here’s where you keep evolving and making changes in your garden that lead to consistent and
*repeatable* success, and you know how to keep that cycle going to continue getting those results
long-term.

## Here’s How I Can Help You…

All of my programs are designed to help you create a naturally balanced, thriving garden you love!
You can [check out all of my offerings here][11].

### Jekka's Herb Farm

Jekka’s is home to the largest collection of culinary herbs in the UK. A family run herb farm on the
outskirts of Bristol with over 40 years’ experience in sustainably growing and using medicinal &
culinary herbs, both plants and seeds. You can visit Jekka's Herb Farm for one of our [**herb
experiences**][174] or during an [**open day**][175]. Please see our [**events calendar**][176] for
dates.

[ Read our story ][177]
[
][178]

### Jekka's Online Herb Shop

Jekka's is continually growing with the development of [**master classes**][179], [**herb seed
collections**][180], a range of illustrated gifts, [**gardener gift boxes**][181], [**grow at home
herb kits**][182] and [**Jekka's herbal infusions**][183]. All available in Jekka's [**online herb
shop**][184]. All our products follow our root of being ‘*green, environmentally friendly and
sustainable*'.

[ Shop now ][185]
[
][186]

### Jekka's Herb Experiences

Jekka’s aim to educate and inspire gardeners and cooks of all ages. Jekka’s offer a variety of
[**herb experiences**][187] from [**open days**][188] to [**master classes**][189] based
around Jekka’s Herbetum. Spend the day at Jekka's and discover our passion for growing sustainable
culinary and medicinal herbs. All herbs are grown following organic principals (read about [**our
approach**][190]).

[ Read more ][191]

Living book of Herbs

A New Chapter at Jekka's

After more than forty years of growing herbs, Jekka's is entering a new chapter.

While we have stepped back from large-scale plant production, our passion for herbs remains
unchanged. Our focus is now on sharing knowledge and inspiring gardeners through Jekka's Herb
Garden, the Herbetum, herb experiences, talks, books and our carefully curated range of seeds and
products.

We look forward to welcoming you to discover, learn and celebrate the wonderful world of herbs with
us.

Shree Agro International is recognized as one of the best organic & IPM spices suppliers and
exporters in India, based in Unjha, Gujarat. Since 1988, with over 32 years of experience, we are
proud to be one of India’s Government-recognized Three Star Export Houses, establishing a reputation
that reassures our partners of our consistent reliability as trusted organic organic spices India .

We are Exporters and suppliers of organic and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) spices From India and
Unjha. categories, offering a comprehensive range of Whole Spices, Ground Spices, and Oilseeds. Our
products are exported to 40+ countries worldwide, including the USA, UK, Europe, China, and the Gulf
region. We export over 21,000 metric tons of seeds annually and supply more than 10,000 metric tons
to leading multinational companies across India.

## Why I Built The Herb Prof?

I spent decades in clinical practice watching people reach for pharmaceutical solutions to problems
that herbs had been solving for centuries. The Herb Prof exists because that knowledge deserves a
proper home: rigorous, practical, and written by someone who has actually used these plants.

The [Ailments section][30] is where I answer the questions patients used to bring to my clinic. Not
generic symptom lists but real guidance on what herbs work, why they work, and when to see a doctor
instead.

Under the Health section I cover the bigger picture: how herbal medicine fits into daily life,
prevention, and long-term wellness. This is where naturopathic thinking meets practical application.

The [Herbs section][31] is my reference library. Every herb I write about is one I have worked with
clinically. You will find its history, its active compounds, its uses, and its cautions. No padding,
no affiliate spin.

If you are new here, start with whatever brought you: a symptom, an herb, a question. That is
exactly what this site is for.

log yields.

forward at WGC Exports.

through sustainable farming practices to not only preserve your health but also the environment.

****Ready to love your garden again?****

**I help frustrated gardeners grow smarter to create beautiful and highly productive gardens that
bring you joy.**

Because struggling just to keep up with all the bugs, weeds, and plant problems is frustrating and
exhausting.
You don’t want more random tips or hacks.
You want clarity on what matters and a system that works in YOUR garden.

**That’s exactly what I’m here for**.

[GROW A THRIVING GARDEN][9]
[Amy's beautiful vegetable garden.]

## Is This Where You’re At Right Now?

✅

You’re capable and hard-working. You know your garden can thrive. You’ve put in the time, the care,
and the heart. And yet, you often feel stuck and frustrated trying to make it all work.

✅

You’re confident with some things, but guessing with others. Your garden starts out strong, but it’s
chaotic by mid-summer, and it seems like you’re constantly fighting one thing after another.

✅

You understand the basics. You’ve had some wins. But your garden feels like it’s hit-or-miss – some
years are better than others, and you just can’t seem to get consistent results.

✅

You know how you want your garden to look. You can picture it in your head. But it isn’t turning out
that way, and it feels like a hot mess that stresses you out every time you look at it.

✅

You’re ready for gardening to feel easier and more consistent. You crave a system that actually
works in YOUR garden, right now, so you can get excited to go outside and enjoy it again.

**Then you’re in the right place!**

Hey there, I’m Amy Andrychowicz

[Picture of Amy Andrychowicz in front of her flower garden.]

## I’ve been there!

I spent years struggling and spinning my wheels, desperately trying to make my garden work.

The more I fought to fix ALL of the problems, the harder it became to manage my garden – and I just

supply chain.
🤝

White-label and private-label options available for selected product categories. From formulation to
final packaging — we handle everything end-to-end.
📦

MOQ.
💬

sample availability.

## From Inquiry to *Shipment*

A clear process for importers, distributors, manufacturers, and private-label buyers looking for a
reliable herbs exporter from Pakistan, rice exporter from Pakistan, botanical supplier Pakistan, or
bulk agricultural products exporter.

1

### Inquiry

Share the product name, required quantity, destination country, grade preference, packing needs, and
intended use. Our export team reviews the requirement and guides you with the most suitable supply
option.

2

### Sample & Specs

Product specifications, available grades, sample options, and packing details are shared according
to the product category. MOQ can vary by product, season, grade, and buyer requirement.

3

### Documentation

Export documents are prepared based on product type and destination requirements. Common documents
may include COA, COO, Phytosanitary, Halal, Fumigation, and SGS/BV support if required.

4

### Shipment

After order, packing, documents, and payment terms are confirmed, shipment is arranged through
Karachi Port or Port Qasim with FOB, CIF, and CFR/CNF options where applicable.

**B2B trade note:** MOQ varies by product, packing can be customized for bulk or retail
requirements, and shipping terms are confirmed according to order size, destination, product
category, and buyer preference.

][173]

### Jekka's Herb Farm

Jekka’s is home to the largest collection of culinary herbs in the UK. A family run herb farm on the
outskirts of Bristol with over 40 years’ experience in sustainably growing and using medicinal &
culinary herbs, both plants and seeds. You can visit Jekka's Herb Farm for one of our [**herb
experiences**][174] or during an [**open day**][175]. Please see our [**events calendar**][176] for
dates.

[ Read our story ][177]
[
][178]

### Jekka's Online Herb Shop

Jekka's is continually growing with the development of [**master classes**][179], [**herb seed
collections**][180], a range of illustrated gifts, [**gardener gift boxes**][181], [**grow at home
herb kits**][182] and [**Jekka's herbal infusions**][183]. All available in Jekka's [**online herb
shop**][184]. All our products follow our root of being ‘*green, environmentally friendly and
sustainable*'.

[ Shop now ][185]
[
][186]

### Jekka's Herb Experiences

Jekka’s aim to educate and inspire gardeners and cooks of all ages. Jekka’s offer a variety of
[**herb experiences**][187] from [**open days**][188] to [**master classes**][189] based
around Jekka’s Herbetum. Spend the day at Jekka's and discover our passion for growing sustainable
culinary and medicinal herbs. All herbs are grown following organic principals (read about [**our
approach**][190]).

[ Read more ][191]

Living book of Herbs

A New Chapter at Jekka's

After more than forty years of growing herbs, Jekka's is entering a new chapter.

While we have stepped back from large-scale plant production, our passion for herbs remains
unchanged. Our focus is now on sharing knowledge and inspiring gardeners through Jekka's Herb
Garden, the Herbetum, herb experiences, talks, books and our carefully curated range of seeds and
products.

We look forward to welcoming you to discover, learn and celebrate the wonderful world of herbs with
us.
